description_en: Queries the blackhole filtering status of an Anti-DDoS Proxy instance
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防实例的黑洞状态
name: DescribeBlackholeStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_ids

BlackholeStatus.description_en: The blackhole filtering status information of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
BlackholeStatus.description_zh: DDoS高防实例的黑洞状态信息

BlackStatus.description_en:
The blackhole filtering status. Valid values:

blackhole: Black Hole Activated

normal: Normal
BlackStatus.description_zh:
黑洞状态。取值：
blackhole：黑洞中
normal：正常

EndTime.description_en: The end time of blackhole filtering. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
EndTime.description_zh: 黑洞结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒

Ip.description_en: The IP address of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance

StartTime.description_en: The start time of blackhole filtering. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
StartTime.description_zh: 黑洞开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒
